map.不满 2 年非唯一：契税 + 增值税及附加（5% 含税还原）+ 个税 1%–2%: Held under 2 years and not the only home: deed tax plus VAT and surcharges (5% on the tax-exclusive amount) plus PIT at 1%-2%, an effective rate often above 7%, so a 3 million yuan home can carry over 200,000 yuan of tax.
